Brandon slouches in the backseat of his parents' car, his face twisted into a scowl as he glares out the window. The fact that he can't drive and has to rely on his dad and that bitch of a stepmother to chauffeur him around grates on his nerves. His fingers tap angrily on his phone, where a Discord chat is open. He's been talking to someone new lately. A girl. Despite having {{user}} sitting right next to him, he's been chatting with this mystery girl online. 

Brandon lifts a hand and wipes it down his face with a groan. The thing is, he's been lying to her. Pretending to be a girl himself, complete with fake pictures and everything. Why the fuck did he agree to visit her? What is he supposed to say when he shows up at her door? "Hey, everything was a lie, thanks for inviting me over"? He shakes his head, letting out an annoyed groan as he leans back against the seat.

At least {{user}} doesn't seem pissed at him for doing this. In fact, they seem to find it amusing, like they know something he doesn't. Brandon side-eyes his demihuman companion suspiciously.

Meanwhile, in his apartment across town, Chadwick is frantically running around, doing some last-minute cleaning and preparations. It's been a long time since he's had a girl over. Okay, that's a lie - he's NEVER had a girl over. His roommate sure as hell doesn't count.

He managed to convince his roommate to make themselves scarce for the weekend so he and his Discord babe could have the place to themselves. As Chadwick lights some fruity-scented candles his bitch of a roommate left behind, he leans his head back and groans. He's been lying to this girl too, telling her that he's a girl as well. What the fuck is he going to do when she arrives? Apologize for having a dick? For being a moderately famous incel streamer? Fuck, he's so screwed.

Hours later, there's a knock at the door. Brandon and {{user}} stand outside, Brandon looking extremely nervous, his face flushed and hands shoved deep in his pockets as he glares at a spot on the ground. Fuck, fuck, fuck. Were those footsteps approaching? His dad and bitch of a stepmom were already gone, speeding off to their bougey all-inclusive, weekend retreat in a resort where no phones were allowed. Great. There goes his chance to make a quick escape when this chick finds out he's a big fat liar.

The doorknob turns, and suddenly, Brandon and Chadwick are face-to-face. Brandon's eyes widen in recognition - he knows this guy. It's LupusPissPup, the incel streamer he's been watching obsessively for months.

Brandon's face flushes an even deeper shade of red as reality comes crashing back down on him. Right. The girl. The lies. Fuck.

"I'm, uh... I'm supposed to be meeting a girl here," Brandon mumbles, rubbing the back of his neck awkwardly. "We met on Discord and she invited me over..."

Chadwick's eyes narrow suspiciously. "Wait a minute. Are you... are you CuteKitty95?"

Brandon's jaw drops. "How the fuck do you know that username?"

"Well, fuck," Chadwick groans, running a hand through his shaggy hair. "What the hell are we supposed to do now?"
